This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career scientists to gain hands-on experience with laboratory techniques, instrumentation, and quality testing in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with laboratory experience through coursework, undergraduate research, internships, co-ops, or industry experience are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Perform laboratory testing and analysis to support product quality, research, and regulatory requirements. Prepare samples, reagents, standards, and testing materials according to laboratory procedures. Collect, analyze, document, and communicate test results accurately. Support testing activities in analytical chemistry, microbiology, stability, and materials laboratories. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment and instrumentation as trained. Maintain laboratory records and documentation in accordance with quality requirements. Collaborate with scientists, analysts, and cross-functional teams to support testing priorities and projects. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and assist with multiple testing assignments. Follow all laboratory safety, quality, and environmental procedures. Basic understanding of laboratory techniques, scientific principles, and good laboratory practices. Strong attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills. Effective communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. QC Analyst Job Description The QC Analyst supports both the Quality Control (QC) Lab and the Feed Lab by performing supplemental product testing and feed sample analysis to handle increased sample volumes. This role focuses on wet chemistry, general laboratory testing, and feed analysis while strictly following GMP and GDP guidelines to ensure accurate, reliable data and timely reporting. Responsibilities Perform wet chemistry and general laboratory product testing in the QC Lab, including sieve analysis, thin layer chromatography, and loss on drying using vacuum ovens. Conduct high-throughput testing, completing approximately 12 to 16 tests per day, while managing weighing and sample preparation for materials ranging from 50 mg to 1 g. Accurately document all product testing results in a lab notebook, adhering to GMP and GDP documentation standards. Receive and log feed samples in the Feed Lab, ensuring proper tracking and chain of custody. Carry out sample preparation for feed analysis, including grinding, weighing, and solution preparation. Analyze customer feed samples using HPLC, column chromatography, and UV-Vis techniques in accordance with established procedures. Record feed analysis results following GMP guidelines and report final results to leadership in a clear and timely manner. Manage a typical feed sample load of approximately 16 samples per day, with flexibility to handle increased volumes during busier periods such as late summer. Follow all established procedures, systems, and methods without making unapproved process changes, ensuring consistency and compliance. Collaborate effectively with both a small team in the Feed Lab and a larger QC team, contributing to a positive and cooperative work environment. Learn new methods, instruments, and workflows quickly, applying training to maintain high testing throughput and quality. Maintain laboratory cleanliness and organization, including proper handling of glassware and samples as needed. Essential Skills Hands-on experience with wet chemistry and general laboratory testing techniques. Proficiency in sieve analysis, thin layer chromatography, and loss on drying (LOD) using vacuum ovens. Ability to perform high-throughput testing, managing 12 to 16 tests per day while maintaining accuracy and quality. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to record data in lab notebooks in full compliance with GMP and GDP standards. Experience with feed sample preparation, including grinding, weighing, and solution preparation. Practical experience analyzing samples using HPLC, column chromatography, and UV-Vis. Understanding and application of GMP guidelines in a QC laboratory environment. BS in Chemistry (ACS-accredited degree) with hands-on undergraduate research experience, preferably involving column chromatography, HPLC, or UV-Vis, or up to 6 months of experience in a QC lab (for the first position). Perform calibration of laboratory instruments and assist in troubleshooting instrument and method performance issues. Job Title: Molecular Lab Analyst Job Description The Molecular Lab Analyst (Laboratory Analyst II) performs general sample preparation, DNA extractions, and routine PCR and qPCR testing to support GMO analysis of agricultural and food products. This role focuses on executing established testing methods, analyzing and documenting results, troubleshooting laboratory processes, supporting quality systems, and maintaining strict compliance with laboratory procedures and regulatory requirements. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing laboratory operation with modern equipment, diverse projects, and a collaborative, family-style team environment, with potential for full-time employment and holiday pay as part of the contract. Responsibilities Perform quantitative and qualitative GMO testing on corn, soy, and processed food products using established PCR and qPCR methods. Prepare samples, including grinding received agricultural and food product samples, and ensure proper handling and labeling throughout the testing process. Prepare reagents, controls, standards, and PCR plates in accordance with laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality standards. Set up and execute PCR and qPCR runs, including manual preparation of reactions without kits, following in-house protocols. Use 96-well plates and transfer to 384-well plates accurately, employing multiple types of pipettes to support high-throughput testing. Analyze test results, perform required calculations, and accurately document findings in laboratory information systems and records. Troubleshoot PCR workflows, instrumentation issues, and testing deviations to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable results. Support nonconformance investigations and root cause analysis activities related to laboratory testing, data integrity, and processes. Perform routine maintenance, calibration checks, and minor repairs on laboratory equipment to maintain optimal performance. Execute and document QA/QC activities in accordance with SOPs, quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements. Assist with SOP revisions and updates to reflect process improvements and current best practices. Support the training of new laboratory staff on procedures, equipment, and quality requirements. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives within the Quality Management System (QMS) to enhance efficiency and quality. Cross-train in mycotoxin testing using LCMS, following established procedures and quality standards. Lift items up to 25 pounds from floor to ceiling as needed during the shift to support sample handling and laboratory operations. Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced testing environment, adapting to changing sample flow and priorities. Collaborate with colleagues to maintain a service-oriented, team-focused culture and demonstrate the value of the growing laboratory. In this role, you perform analytical and wet chemistry testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products while ensuring full compliance with FDA and GMP requirements. Document all testing activities accurately and completely in compliance with GMP and FDA requirements, ensuring data integrity and traceability. Review analytical results and communicate findings clearly with Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional departments to support timely decision-making. Support method execution and validation-related activities as needed, contributing to the development and improvement of analytical methods. Participate in cross-training opportunities across analytical, raw materials, and microbiology laboratories to expand capabilities and provide flexible support. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and laboratory safety guidelines at all times while maintaining a clean, organized, and compliant work area. Work independently on an off-shift schedule while collaborating effectively with a small team of laboratory colleagues. Job Title: Quality Assurance Analyst Job Description The Quality Assurance Analyst ensures that production and sanitation practices in the plant meet all required standards, with a strong focus on compliance with internal quality guidelines as well as USDA and FDA regulations. This role involves auditing processes, collecting and evaluating samples, monitoring packaging and operating practices, and performing product checks to verify that all specifications are consistently met. Responsibilities Audit production practices and sanitation procedures within the plant to verify adherence to established quality and safety standards. Collect assigned chemical, microbiological, and environmental samples according to defined protocols. Examine product packaging to ensure it meets company, USDA, and FDA requirements. Monitor operating practices on the production floor to confirm compliance with regulatory and internal guidelines. Perform product checks to ensure all specifications and quality parameters are consistently met. Issue accurate and timely quality assurance reports based on audits, inspections, and sample results. Place product holds when quality issues are identified and release QA-approved products once specifications and standards are confirmed. Support compliance initiatives related to HACCP, USDA, FDA, and GMP requirements. Work collaboratively with production and sanitation teams to address nonconformances and support corrective actions. Maintain detailed documentation of quality activities, inspections, and sample results in a lab and office environment. Essential Skills Minimum of 6 months of experience working in a GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) environment. Familiarity with HACCP principles and related food safety programs. Working knowledge of USDA regulations applicable to production and sanitation practices. Understanding of FDA requirements related to product quality and safety. Ability to perform quality assurance and quality control activities in a lab environment. Strong attention to detail when auditing processes, examining packaging, and reviewing operating practices. Capability to follow established procedures for collecting and handling chemical, microbiological, and environmental samples. Effective communication skills to issue clear QA reports and collaborate with production and sanitation teams. Knowledge of compliance processes and documentation in regulated environments. Comfort working with both office-based documentation and laboratory testing procedures.
